d:
Silver prices have fallen sharply in India just before Dhanteras and Diwali. In this episode of Kharcha Pani, we explain why silver prices crashed, how silver gave massive returns in 2025 and early 2026, why prices have fallen recently, how physical silver compares with Silver ETFs, and why silver is more volatile than gold. We also break down 1-year returns, recent 10-day movement, festive demand, industrial demand, and the outlook for silver investors and buyers in India.
